flags.title: Reserve fund at 63% of recommended level
flags.explanation: The reserve fund holds $660,000 against a study-recommended $1,050,000 — about 63% funded. The study rates 70%+ as 'good', so this building sits below that bar even before the anticipated parkade project.

flags.title: Parkade membrane replacement anticipated 2026, not yet funded
flags.explanation: The 2024 reserve study anticipates parkade membrane replacement in 2026 at an estimated $700,000, explicitly listed as not yet funded. With reserves at 63%, this is a likely future special assessment — roughly $8,300 per unit if levied evenly.

questions_for_realtor_lawyer: How will the board fund the $700,000 parkade membrane replacement anticipated for 2026?

summary: North Hill Terrace's 2024 documents show a building in decent shape but with a known bill coming: the parkade membrane is expected to need replacement in 2026 at about $700,000, with no funding plan yet, and reserves sit at 63% of the recommended level.
